note: Named failure mechanisms with detection signatures and their countermeasures. Grown from real films; every entry cites the station/gate that exists because of it.

families.mechanism: repeated same-file patches inside a red span instead of re-pouring the function from its contract
families.signature: replaces-per-path >= 4 within a span where the suite stayed red

families.mechanism: earlier prompt bytes changed between builds (history rewriter), collapsing checkpoint-or-nothing prefix reuse to the head
families.signature: cache_n collapse with large prompt_n mid-run; extensionPrefixBreaks > 0

families.mechanism: an enumerated contract implemented in full but tested in part; the untested entries hide the defect
families.signature: contract-flagged task + small self-suite + sealed/holdout failure on a listed item

families.mechanism: truth channel drifts from the asserting suite to print-only probes; escalations sleep because nothing registers pass/fail
environment lacks a dependency/network; the model burns turns on varied installers that all hit the same wall
families.signature: multiple distinct install/download commands failing with network-unreachable errors

families.mechanism: byte-inverse edit pairs on one path; the run alternates between two already-tested states
families.signature: a replace whose (old,new) is the inverse of an earlier landed replace, twice

families.mechanism: a station fired correctly but the following actions repeat the steered-against behavior; advice compiles stochastically
families.signature: steer metric > 0 and the same pattern continues in later turns

countermeasure.name: promote the advisory to a gate (see contract_coverage precedent)

families.mechanism: values computed in probes then hand-transcribed as long literal tables; one slipped digit re-introduces the corruption
families.signature: large literal tables written where the task documents a generating formula
